results.title: Caracas SIGAT municipal cadastre portal
results.note: Portal of Libertador Municipality’s tax/revenue superintendency and municipal cadastre directorate. The directorate is responsible for physical/economic/legal property inventory, cadastral certificates, boundary certifications and land-title information; public vector endpoint not identified.

results.title: Caracas multipurpose cadastre project
results.note: Describes municipal parcel characteristics viewer and cadastral GIS for Libertador; no anonymous feature service URL surfaced.

assessment: Spanish-language search found an official municipal cadastral portal and a map-based cadastre project for Libertador, which covers the core Caracas municipality. This is a strong lead but does not verify an open vector layer, exact-ID service or coverage of the wider metropolitan area.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
